result.description: A fictional ultra-low-power desktop display built for document review, annotation, and long-form reading. The NovaLens uses a 27-inch monochrome e-ink panel with adjustable front light, portrait/landscape support, and USB-C display input. It is optimized for eye comfort rather than gaming or color-critical work, with a matte finish, low refresh rate, and integrated stand for fixed-office use.
